$description: Erika Aldrich Murga — portfolio design system foundations (DTCG 2025.10), v2. Reflects the current Figma file: single-mode (web-canonical), Tailwind-style type/radius/shadow scales. Colors authored in OKLCH (preserved in $extensions).

primitive.$description: Raw color ramps — 11 even-lightness OKLCH steps per family. Hidden from pickers in Figma; semantic tokens alias these.

brand.$description: Pinned brand chartreuse (#EBFC72). Sits between lime/50 and lime/100; the exact signature color. Fills only — never text on light.

olive.$description: Deep olive — ink, dark surfaces, primary action.

brass.$description: Bronze — links and warm metallic accent.

background.$description: Semantic surface fills. Figma scope: FRAME_FILL, SHAPE_FILL.

page.$description: App canvas behind everything — warm paper base for all pages and long-form reading.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, modals. Lighter than the page so they lift; pair with elevation and border/default.

sunken.$description: Recessed zones — alternating bands, wells, table stripes, code blocks. One step deeper than the page.

input.$description: Text inputs, textareas, selects. Pair with border/strong so the field edge meets 3:1.

inverse.$description: Dark feature sections and footer; pair with foreground/inverse and lime accents.

brand.$description: Full-bleed brand bands, hero blocks, statement sections. Dark olive content only.

brand-subtle.$description: Soft lime wash for gentle emphasis blocks, callouts, active-nav background.

accent.$description: Hero CTA fill and key attention moments — chartreuse with olive text.

accent-hover.$description: Hover state for the accent CTA.

accent-pressed.$description: Pressed state for the accent CTA.

action.$description: Primary button and filled-control fill at rest.

disabled.$description: Disabled button/control fill; pair with foreground/disabled.

success.$description: Success banners, toasts, inline confirmation fills.

warning.$description: Caution banners and inline warning fills.

error.$description: Error banners and form-error message fills.

info.$description: Neutral / system info banners and tips.

overlay.$description: Scrim behind modals, drawers, lightboxes — deep olive (olive/950) at 60%. Raw value: transparency can't alias.

foreground.$description: Semantic text/icon colors. Figma scope: TEXT_FILL, SHAPE_FILL.

primary.$description: Body copy and headings — main reading color (13:1 on card, 10.5:1 on page).

secondary.$description: Supporting copy, subheads, deck text (AAA on page).

muted.$description: Captions, metadata, helper text (AA on page).

disabled.$description: Disabled labels only — never for essential info.

link.$description: Inline links — warm bronze; always underline, never color alone.

link-hover.$description: Link hover/focus — darkens to ink; pair with a lime underline.

on-accent.$description: Text/icons on the lime CTA and lime brand bands.

brand.$description: Brand-colored text = the olive ink (chartreuse can't carry text on light).

error.$description: Error message text and validation copy (AAA).

info.$description: Info / system message text and icons (AAA).

border.$description: Semantic border/stroke colors. Figma scope: STROKE_COLOR.

subtle.$description: Hairline dividers inside components — list rows, table cells, menu items.

default.$description: Standard card outlines and section dividers on the page.

strong.$description: Functional edges needing 3:1 — input outlines, unchecked controls, segmented buttons.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring on light (2px ring + 2px offset). Use accent/brand on dark surfaces.

brand.$description: Brand underlines and accent rules that must read on light. True chartreuse only shows on dark.

success.$description: Success input outlines and message rules.

error.$description: Error input outlines and invalid-field borders.

info.$description: Info message rules and neutral highlighted borders.

accent.$description: Badge, icon, indicator, and data-mark fills. Figma scope: FRAME_FILL, SHAPE_FILL.

brand.$description: Chartreuse fills — badges, indicators, icon accents, large brand shapes. On dark or with dark text.

brand-strong.$description: When lime must read on a light background — small icons, dots, thin underlines, progress fills.

sage.$description: Calm decorative accent — tags, category chips, illustration fills for the service-design work.

brass.$description: Warm metallic accent — pull-quote marks, entrepreneurship/CPG section flavor.

success.$description: Status dots, icon fills, chart markers — positive.

heading.$description: Hero display face only (font/heading). High-contrast Didone.

display.$description: Display/heading roles below the hero (font/display). Contemporary grotesque.

scale.$description: Single-mode (web) type roles. fontSize in rem, lineHeight as unitless multiplier, letterSpacing in px.

display-2xl.$description: Hero statement — one per page. Bodoni Moda.

display-xl.$description: Oversized display — big section openers, pull-stats.

text-sm-label.$description: Buttons, input labels, nav items, tabs, chips.

text-xs-overline.$description: Eyebrows, category markers, tags. UPPERCASE, wide-tracked.

none.$description: Full-bleed — brand bands, edge-to-edge backgrounds, hero images.

xs.$description: Extra-small rounding — inline code, tiny controls.

sm.$description: Small controls — chips, tags, badges, checkboxes.

md.$description: Workhorse default — buttons, inputs, selects, small cards.

xl.$description: Prominent surfaces — modals, feature cards, thumbnails.

pill.$description: Fully rounded — pills, chips, avatars, status dots.

none.$description: Flat — no shadow. Default resting state.

sm.$description: Resting cards, subtle separation from the sand background.

md.$description: Floating — dropdowns, popovers, tooltips, hover-raised cards.

lg.$description: Plane-breaking — modals, dialogs, sheets. Pair with background/overlay.
